t: A federation of seven emirates formed in 1971–1972 from the British-protected Trucial States, with Abu Dhabi as its capital.
Abu Dhabi's oil and Dubai's ports, airline and free zones made it a global hub of trade, finance and aviation.
Since the 2010s it has acted as an assertive regional power, from Yemen to the Abraham Accords with Israel in 2020.
dyk: The UAE's Hope probe, which entered orbit around Mars in February 2021, was the first interplanetary mission by an Arab country.
ev: Zayed and Rashid agree to form a union after Britain announces its withdrawal from the Gulf
Six sheikhdoms proclaim the United Arab Emirates on 2 December
Ras al-Khaimah joins as the seventh emirate
Jebel Ali port opens; Rashid of Dubai becomes prime minister
The Gulf Cooperation Council is founded in Abu Dhabi
Zayed dies and is succeeded by Khalifa bin Zayed
Abu Dhabi rescues Dubai during the Dubai World debt crisis
The UAE signs the Abraham Accords with Israel
